headline: Business Development Manager | B2B Sales, Strategic Partnerships & Market Growth
summary: Results-oriented Business Development professional with a Bachelor of Business Administration and extensive experience in driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships and client acquisition. Proven track record in managing complex B2B sales cycles, negotiating high-value contracts, and building robust networks with key stakeholders across MENA. Skilled in market intelligence, pipeline management, and delivering ROI-based value propositions to enterprise clients. Adept at cross-functional collaboration with technical and marketing teams to tailor solutions that meet specific vertical needs, ensuring sustainable market expansion and brand positioning.

experience.title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
bullets: Drove revenue growth by identifying and closing new business opportunities across MENA, EU, and Asian markets, consistently exceeding quarterly sales targets.
Built and managed strategic relationships with key accounts, influencers, and system integrators, positioning the brand as a market leader through value-oriented engagement.
Conducted comprehensive market intelligence on competitors and pricing trends to inform go-to-market strategies and optimize sales funnels.
Collaborated with technical and creative teams to develop customized proposals and data-driven campaigns that enhanced client retention and acquisition.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Managed end-to-end user growth and engagement, fostering long-term relationships with a diverse user base and key opinion leaders (KOLs).
Executed strategic outreach and partnership initiatives that expanded market reach and qualified high-potential project opportunities.
Coordinated with cross-functional teams to align community activities with broader business development goals and product launches.
Analyzed customer feedback and market trends to refine sales approaches and improve conversion rates in a competitive environment.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer & Creative Strategist
bullets: Delivered 150+ successful projects for clients across 12+ countries, demonstrating strong client management, negotiation, and deadline-driven delivery capabilities.
Managed the full client lifecycle from initial consultation and requirement gathering to final delivery and post-sales support, ensuring 100% client satisfaction.
Developed automated systems and integrated solutions that optimized client operations, showcasing technical understanding of complex system integrations.
Maintained rigorous documentation and communication standards, facilitating seamless collaboration with international stakeholders.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Business Development Manager role at Hikvision MEA. With a background in driving growth and managing strategic partnerships across the MENA region, I bring a proven ability to identify, qualify, and close high-value B2B opportunities. My experience in navigating complex sales cycles, conducting market intelligence, and building lasting relationships with key accounts aligns perfectly with Hikvision's goal of expanding its Non-Video portfolio. I am eager to leverage my skills in ROI-based selling and cross-functional collaboration to contribute to Hikvision's continued success in Egypt's integrated security sector.

screening.q: Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field?
screening.a: Yes, I hold a Bachelor of Business Administration.

screening.q: Do you have 5+ years of B2B sales experience in security, ELV, ICT, or integrated solutions?
Do you have a proven track record in managing non-video product lines or multi-solution portfolios?
Do you have a strong network with system integrators, consultants, and distributors?
